summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for an exciting 2026/27 season with just one week until kick-off, having welcomed some fantastic new signings and one returning player to bolster the squad. The Ramblers put on a competitive display against St Helens in their recent friendly, though fell short as their opponents made their chances count. With three brand new kits now in place, the club is actively seeking sponsorship partners ahead of what promises to be a promotion-chasing campaign.
